note: OSV lists no fix commit; from the advisory. readHeaders strips a conflicting Content-Length only for HTTP/1.1, through handleTransferEncodingChunkedWithContentLength (present from 4.1.50, absent in 4.1.0); readHeaders is present in 4.1.0, 4.1.50, 4.1.100, 4.1.131, 4.2.0 and 4.2.12.
